highlights: AI agents currently complete a negligible share of hotel bookings, but discovery is shifting fast, and hotels not connected for direct checkout will default to OTA-mediated sales when in-chat booking scales. Here's what the curve looks like, and who's positioned to win when it bends. **85% of consumers** are happy for an AI agent to find products, but only **1 in 10** would let it complete the purchase (Mastercard). The trigger is checkout moving inside the AI: Google's AI Mode has been completing hotel bookings for US users since August, Cloudbeds' connection to Meta's AI assistant is due in Q1 2027, and Airbnb launches its own AI travel agent in the first half of 2027. **The takeaway:** if an agent can't book you directly, it will book you through an OTA and the commission goes with it. But test it today: ask ChatGPT and Google's AI Mode to book a room at your hotel on a night you have availability.

highlights: AI agents currently complete a negligible share of hotel bookings, but discovery is shifting fast, and hotels not connected for direct checkout will default to OTA-mediated sales when in-chat booking scales. Here's what the curve looks like, and who's positioned to win when it bends. **85% of consumers** are happy for an AI agent to find products, but only **1 in 10** would let it complete the purchase (Mastercard). The trigger is checkout moving inside the AI: Google's AI Mode has been completing hotel bookings for US users since August, Cloudbeds' connection to Meta's AI assistant is due in Q1 2027, and Airbnb launches its own AI travel agent in the first half of 2027. **The takeaway:** if an agent can't book you directly, it will book you through an OTA and the commission goes with it. But test it today: ask ChatGPT and Google's AI Mode to book a room at your hotel on a night you have availability.

month.title: Four. - Hospitality Net
month.summary: AI agents currently complete a negligible share of hotel bookings, but discovery is shifting fast, and hotels not connected for direct checkout will default to OTA-mediated sales when in-chat booking ...
highlights: AI agents currently complete a negligible share of hotel bookings, but discovery is shifting fast, and hotels not connected for direct checkout will default to OTA-mediated sales when in-chat booking scales. Here's what the curve looks like, and who's positioned to win when it bends. **85% of consumers** are happy for an AI agent to find products, but only **1 in 10** would let it complete the purchase (Mastercard). The trigger is checkout moving inside the AI: Google's AI Mode has been completing hotel bookings for US users since August, Cloudbeds' connection to Meta's AI assistant is due in Q1 2027, and Airbnb launches its own AI travel agent in the first half of 2027. **The takeaway:** if an agent can't book you directly, it will book you through an OTA and the commission goes with it. But test it today: ask ChatGPT and Google's AI Mode to book a room at your hotel on a night you have availability.
